body.statement: For every finite directed graph \(G=(V,E^{\to}(G))\), there exists a directed graph \(\widehat G\) on \(V\) such that \(\widehat G\equiv_E G\) and \(H\subseteq\widehat G\) for every directed graph \(H\) on \(V\) satisfying \(H\equiv_EG\).

source.verbatim_statement: The Markov equivalence class of \(G\) contains a greatest element with respect to the partial order \(\subseteq\).

attestation.note: Transcribed from Theorem 3.12 of the cited PMLR paper.
